style: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE fictional character portrait for A-Discord, closely MATCHING THE TWO PROVIDED STYLE REFERENCES. Both images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not identity targets. Match their HOI4/TFR mod photomontage look: cutout realistic photograph of head and shoulders, heavily processed crunchy sharp edges, deep shadows, strong contrast, slightly posterized gritty photoreal shading, muted skin and clothing, pale lavender at top shading to dark purple at bottom background, fine tightly spaced horizontal CRT scanlines uniformly across the entire image including the person. Digital game portrait collage, NOT oil painting, NOT fine-art portrait, NOT a soft studio photograph. Vertical 156:210 aspect ratio. VERY TIGHT framing: head almost fills width, top of head near upper edge, eyes around upper third, upper chest cut by bottom edge. Photo-collage with subtly dark cutout edge. The supplied references define finishing, colors, scanline texture and framing. The new person has their own fictional identity; do not copy the reference people's faces, sunglasses, cigarette, real flags, military insignia or uniform emblems. No text, border, watermark, insignia, symbols or decorative props. Setting: Shahrabad, a Persian-flavoured industrial oligarchy of furnace-owning houses in a desert country; faces and names are Iranian in character, clothing is modern industrial-era civilian dress with restrained Persian cut (high collars, long dark coats, plain shawl collars, no turbans, no robes, no jewellery except a single signet ring where noted). Furnace light and desert sun have marked the skin.
